title: Nha Trang in a day
summary: Start on the Trần Phú sand, eat the Ninh Hòa bowl, and keep the afternoon for Po Nagar, Long Sơn, and the night market behind 46 Trần Phú.

stops.name: Nha Trang Beach
stops.note: Swim and walk the sand along Trần Phú in the morning.

stops.name: Bún cá Ninh Hòa
stops.note: Eat the Ninh Hòa fish-noodle bowl in the morning or the evening.

stops.name: Po Nagar
stops.note: Walk the brick shrines about 2 km north of the centre.

stops.name: Long Sơn Pagoda
stops.note: Climb to the seated white Buddha in daylight.

stops.name: Trần Phú night market
stops.note: Walk the food stalls behind 46 Trần Phú after dark.

additions.name: Hòn Tre Cable Car
additions.note: Ride the cable across the bay when the island is the point of the day.

seoTitle: Nha Trang in a day — sand, then Po Nagar
seoDescription: One day in Nha Trang: Trần Phú in the morning, bún cá, Po Nagar, Long Sơn, and the night market behind 46 Trần Phú.
